description: Source code for the DiskStore class in Apache Spark, responsible for storing BlockManager blocks on disk, including methods for reading, writing, encrypting, and managing block data.

classes.name: DiskStore
classes.description: Manages storing and retrieving blocks on disk, including encryption support and file management.

classes.name: DiskBlockData
classes.description: Represents disk-based block data with methods for conversion to input streams, ByteBuffers, and Netty regions.

classes.name: EncryptedBlockData
classes.description: Represents encrypted disk block data with methods for decryption and conversion to various formats.

classes.name: EncryptedManagedBuffer
classes.description: ManagedBuffer implementation for encrypted block data.

classes.name: ReadableChannelFileRegion
classes.description: Netty file region for reading data from a ReadableByteChannel.

classes.name: CountingWritableChannel
classes.description: WritableByteChannel that counts the number of bytes written.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a block given its BlockId.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a block on disk by executing a write function with a writable channel.

methods.name: putBytes
methods.description: Stores a ChunkedByteBuffer as a block.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves block data as BlockData, handling encryption if necessary.

methods.name: moveFileToBlock
methods.description: Moves a source file to a new block with specified size.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a block exists in disk storage.

methods.name: openForWrite
methods.description: Opens a file channel for writing, applying encryption if configured.
